title: Special Executive Programme In International Tourism Business
description: The aim of the special executive programme is to equip students with the knowledge and skills necessary to manage and grow businesses in the global tourism industry, focusing on cross-cultural dynamics, sustainable practices, and international market strategies.
longDescription: The special executive programme provides a comprehensive understanding of the global tourism industry and the strategies needed to succeed in international tourism business. Participants will explore key areas such as market analysis, customer segmentation, destination management, and sustainable tourism practices. The course also covers the impact of globalization on tourism trends, focusing on international marketing, cross-cultural communication, and regulatory environments. In addition, participants will delve into the operational aspects of international tourism businesses, including supply chain management, service quality, and digital marketing strategies. The role of innovation and technology in shaping the future of tourism will be examined, along with the importance of responsible tourism practices that benefit both the economy and local communities. By understanding these concepts, participants will be equipped to develop and manage tourism ventures that cater to global markets while adhering to ethical and sustainable standards. This course is ideal for professionals looking to enhance their expertise in managing and growing tourism businesses in an increasingly interconnected world.
courseDetails: Explain the role and importance of tourism planning in promoting sustainable tourism development. Describe the components of integrated planning and how they contribute to successful tourism development. Analyze the need for tourism planning in a particular destination, taking into account social, environmental, and economic factors. Explain the tourism development process, including market analysis, site selection, and economic feasibility assessment. Assess the socioeconomic impact of international tourism on destination countries and communities. Evaluate the legal issues and challenges that arise in tourism planning and development, such as land use regulations, zoning laws, and environmental protection measures. Analyze the role of leadership in promoting tourism development and sustainability in a destination. Explain the organizational process of tourism development and the formation of leadership within tourism organizations. Evaluate different leadership roles in the tourism industry and their contribution to successful tourism development. Describe the leadership development process within the community and how it can lead to sustainable tourism development. Analyze the importance of tourism coordination in promoting successful tourism development and stakeholder engagement. Explain the importance of visitor services in promoting a positive tourist experience and the role of leadership in ensuring high-quality visitor services. Develop a training program for tourism team members to improve their visitor service skills and enhance the overall tourist experience. Evaluate the public awareness of international tourism in a particular destination, including cultural awareness and sensitivity to tourists from different backgrounds. Understand International Tourism Marketing challenges. Learn to develop the promotional plan. Learn how to Determine marketing objectives. Explore and Develop an appropriate message. Select the promotional mix. Understand Tourism distribution systems. Learn the role of tourism wholesaler and retail travel agent. Learn how to create Demand for Tourism. Acknowledge the factors affecting tourism demand. Travel & Tourism Employment. Tourism and American Economy. Understand International Tourism's contribution to the GDP of Africa. Know about Asia Pacific and International Tourism. Explore the role of Tourism in the European Economy. Understand the role of the International Tourism Business and the Middle East Economy. Explore the dynamic and ever-evolving world of the international tourism business. You'll gain insights into industry trends, innovative marketing strategies, and cross-cultural communication skills to thrive in this exciting and rewarding field. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Introduction to International Tourism: International Tourism Planning and Development Process: Leadership development in the tourism industry: Tourism promotion and travel distribution system: Future Trends in International Tourism Business and its Contribution to the World Economy:

modules.title: INTERNATIONAL TOURISM BUSINESS
modules.summary: The International Tourism Business module explores the global tourism industry, including its economic, social, and environmental impacts, and the various stakeholders involved in its management. Students will examine tourism marketing strategies, destination development, and sustainability practices, as well as gain an understanding of the role of technology in the industry. Through case studies and practical exercises, students will develop their skills in analyzing and addressing the challenges international tourism businesses face in today's rapidly changing global marketplace.
